test.create_query: CREATE TABLE lc_many_marks_point_lookups ( k String, ts UInt32, lc1 LowCardinality(String), lc2 LowCardinality(String), v UInt64 ) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY (k, ts) SETTINGS index_granularity = 8, min_bytes_for_wide_part = 0, min_rows_for_wide_part = 0

INSERT INTO lc_many_marks_point_lookups SELECT 'K' || toString(number % 200), number % 5000, ['alpha', 'beta', 'gamma'][(number % 3) + 1], 'constant', number FROM numbers(4000000) SETTINGS max_insert_threads = 1
